caller_asset_contract.revision_policy: A caller must supply a full 40-hex upstream commit, but no upstream commit has been observed or approved.  Structural acceptance never sets revision_pinned or qualification.
caller_asset_contract.notes: All seven class checkpoints, the Whisper-Large-v3 weights and config, label map, runtime lock, licence, consent and cohort record must exist at absolute paths and match their declared SHA-256 before a caller may process audio.  The validator never imports the source or a runtime.

exact_blockers.requirement: Supply a checkout of PSI-TAMU/AccentCL at one full 40-hex upstream commit; no AccentCL checkout exists in the workspace or this worktree and the merged evidence publishes no revision.
Publish exact filenames, byte counts and SHA-256 values for all seven accent-class checkpoints; the merged evidence records only approximately 2.56 GB per checkpoint.
Supply the Whisper-Large-v3 backbone weights and configuration with exact byte counts, SHA-256 values and an immutable distribution revision.
Provide a hash-pinned isolated AccentCL runtime with a complete lock at data/envs/accentcl/requirements.lock on a recorded platform; no AccentCL environment was ever created.
Add and review the upstream source and weight licence; no AccentCL licence file, model card terms or redistribution grant has been observed.
Clear weight, training-data, speech-corpus, speaker-reference, consent, output-use and redistribution rights with complete notices.
Freeze a rights-cleared accent cohort with exact class labels, class ordering, language and speaker groups, and held-out ground truth; no label map or cohort manifest exists.
Produce an approved exact-runtime AccentCL parity vector on frozen 16 kHz mono PCM for one frozen checkpoint set, including the seven-class posterior, argmax and fresh-process reset.

gates.requirement: The full 40-hex AccentCL revision, seven checkpoint SHA-256 values, Whisper-Large-v3 manifest, label map and source licence match exact pins.
An isolated hash-pinned runtime with a complete lock is admitted on a recorded platform.
Source, weight, training-data, speech-corpus, consent, output-use and redistribution rights are cleared with complete notices.
An approved exact-runtime seven-class posterior and argmax match the reference on frozen 16 kHz mono PCM for one frozen checkpoint set.
A rights-cleared held-out cohort scores accuracy, macro-F1, calibration and per-class confusion with frozen language and speaker groups.
The offline whole-utterance classifier is reproduced and never presented as incremental streaming; first-output and tail timing are measured if an adapter is ever proposed.
Explicit opt-in adapter intake, licence review, descriptor review and an independent public-surface decision are complete.
Explicit default selection, resource/deadline evidence and release or public-benchmark approval are recorded; this package is off by default.

voice_profile_requirements.requirement: Freeze permitted input and target references with rights and consent.
Freeze task, language and speaker groups for the cohort.
Preserve text and semantic content as its own outcome.
Measure identity or similarity to the target as a separate outcome.
Measure naturalness as a separate outcome.
Record alignment, first-output and tail timing for the exact runtime.
Treat consent, reference availability and output use as independent gates.
